faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions we get on the 30-minute strategy call. Email us if yours isn't here.

items.a: Our smallest paid engagement is the 30-Day AI Kickstart at $5-15K. After that, monthly retainers start at $300/mo for hosting + maintenance, and project work typically ranges $5-50K depending on scope.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Paraguay?
items.a: Yes. About 40% of our work is for clients in the EU (especially Netherlands, Belgium, Germany), 50% is Paraguay, 10% is US. We have 4-locale delivery (es/en/nl/pt) and async-friendly working hours.

items.q: Can I hire you for just one thing, like a WhatsApp bot?
items.a: Yes. The WhatsApp AI Agent is $1-3K setup + $300-1,000/mo. We have a templated product for this. Most clients start with one agent, then expand to more.

items.q: Do you use no-code tools or do you actually code?
items.a: We code. TypeScript, Python, Rust, depending on the project. We use no-code only when the client specifically asks for it (and even then, we wrap it in code so it doesn't become brittle). 100% of our public GitHub is real code.

items.q: What if my project fails or doesn't deliver ROI?
items.a: The 30-Day Kickstart is designed to fail fast: by the end of week 1 you have the audit, and by the end of week 2 you have a working PoC. If the audit says "don't build this" or the PoC doesn't move the needle, you don't continue. We've never had a client pay for the full kickstart and walk away with nothing — and we publish the cases where we say "this is a bad idea, here's why."

items.q: Who owns the code when we're done?
items.a: You do. 100%. Source code, documentation, infrastructure config, all transferred to your GitHub org on day one. No vendor lock-in. We publish our open-source work; we'd be hypocrites to keep yours closed.

items.q: Why are you a 2-person team? Can you scale?
items.a: We scale with 8 named AI bots (Erebus, explorer-bot, closer-bot, copy-bot, architect-bot, client-success-bot, delivery-bot, ops-bot) and a curated network of trusted partners for overflow. We don't do staff augmentation. If your project needs 20 engineers, we're not the right fit.

Free 30-minute strategy call. No sales pitch. We'll either tell you what to do (and you can do it yourself), suggest a 30-Day Kickstart, or refer you to someone better-suited if it's not our wheelhouse.

steps.title: System audit & feasibility
steps.body: We map your workflows, interview your team, and identify the top 5-10 high-leverage automation candidates. We score each by ROI, technical feasibility, and political ease. Deliverable: 30-page engineering audit with prioritised roadmap.

steps.title: Agent architecture design
steps.body: We design the agent architecture using our published 20-pattern framework. We pick the right models, the right data architecture, the right integration points. We prototype the core agent behavior with a real working slice. Deliverable: architecture blueprint + functional prototype.

steps.title: Production deployment
steps.body: We deploy to your infrastructure (or ours) with proper observability, error handling, and a tested rollback path. We wire up your existing tools via MCP. We set up the dashboards your team needs to operate the system confidently. Deliverable: production-ready system with full source code handoff.

steps.title: Ongoing support & optimisation
steps.body: Optional 90-day engineering support to fine-tune the system based on real production data. Monthly performance reviews. Model fine-tuning recommendations as your usage patterns evolve. Deliverable: continuous engineering support.
